payload.text:
I approved the branch for QA. It's a two-line change in `public/index.html` that matches the plan.

The `<h1>` now has an id, and `render()` sets its text to `Todos (N left)` from the list it has just fetched. `render()` already runs on page load, after adding a todo and after ticking one. That covers every acceptance criterion, including `Todos (0 left)` when there are no todos or all are done. I only read the diff. I didn't run the linter or any tests, and I didn't open the page.

I reported one cross-ticket warning. EV0XEBCZ-2 also edits `public/index.html`. A small textual merge conflict is possible, but the two changes are compatible.
